result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: duplicated restaurant cards, truncated restaurant name, and inconsistent image sizing in the Fastest near you carousel.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side-by-side in 'Fastest near you' with same image, same '15-25 min' badge and same '€0.90 delivery' text
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the feed so distinct restaurants are shown; check data source for duplicate entries

issues.description: Third card title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated mid-word as 'Smash Bros Bu' with no ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Fix text overflow handling with proper ellipsis or wrapping and ensure full name is visible on scroll or detail view

issues.description: First two cards in 'Fastest near you' show tiny centered bowl illustration with large empty beige background while the third burger card is full-bleed, looking like broken image sizing
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image scaling (e.g., cover/fill and same aspect ratio) for all carousel cards
